title: Structures Loot Tweak
description: Balances the loot of modded structures chests.
body:
Balances the loot of around 240 structures' chests and barrels to render exploration less overpowered, especially when structures are common throughout the world, while increasing the rewards of underpowered structures. Compatible with various mods' structures.

 

Also removes the more controversial and offensive items added in ATI Structures. Loot added to the rare Underground Bunkers include various technology mod items such as items from Applied Energistics 2, the Thermal Series, Solar Flux Reborn and Mekanism. These mods are optional, but can be installed to increase the rewards of the Underground Bunkers.

 

Compatible mods:

*   ATI Structures
*   Create Easy Structures
*   Dungeons Arise
*   Dungeons Arise: Seven Seas
*   Elementalcraft
*   Irons' Spells and Spellbooks
*   Luki's Grand Capitals
*   Underground Bunkers

Feel free to use in your modpack.
